60 seats (official current MBA page)
Published numeric intake: 60
fields.Fees — Published: Official MBA annual fee approximately ₹1,45,000: tuition ₹59,700 + other charges ₹85,300. Two-year reference ₹2.90 lakh assumes unchanged annual charges.
fields.Fee Scope: Derived 2 × official approximate annual fee; not a guaranteed two-year invoice. Annual revision and living costs require confirmation.
fields.Accepted Exams: University admission route / direct admission under AKTU, UP Government and AICTE rules
fields.Eligibility: Bachelor’s degree ≥50%; 5 percentage-point relaxation for SC/ST
fields.Selection Process: University test / counselling route; direct route uses group discussion and personal interview as notified
fields.Application / Vacancy Signal: Current programme and 2026–27 admission pages; no live vacancy count verified
fields.Avg CTC — Published: No separate MBA cohort mean. Official group placement page reports ₹4.5 lakh mean for 2023–24
fields.Highest CTC — Published: No separate MBA cohort highest. Official group page reports ₹12 lakh+ for 2023–24
fields.Placement — Published: Placement assistance; group totals 1,500+ students and 250+ recruiter partners do not establish MBA placement rate
fields.Placement Scope: IPEM group-wide 2023–24; MBA programme not separated
fields.Programme-Aligned Career Paths: Finance Analyst; Marketing / Sales; HR; Operations; Business Analytics
fields.Notes: Official MBA page confirms active two-year programme and 60 seats. It describes annual ₹1.45 lakh fee. Third-party total ₹2.08 lakh differs; official annual figure takes priority. Group placement metrics are kept separate from MBA actuals.

fields.Fee estimate basis:
Unchanged-fee planning scenario, not a confirmed two-year total: official approximate annual ₹1.45 lakh (tuition ₹59,700 + other charges ₹85,300) × 2 years = ₹2.90 lakh. The second-year rate and exact treatment of one-time charges are not separately published. Identical low/high values represent this single scenario, not a guaranteed price or uncertainty interval. Hostel, living costs and any separately billed charges are excluded.
